run_elevater: run the Elevater zero-shot and linear probe evaluation on a CLIP model across multiple datasets and shot settings
run_elevater_on: run the Elevater evaluation pipeline on a PyTorch model by saving its state dict and evaluating across datasets
run_elevator_from_lora_checkpoint: run the Elevater evaluation on a LoRA fine-tuned CLIP model by merging the adapter weights and evaluating
DATASETS_LIST: review the list of 20 benchmark datasets used for zero-shot and linear probe evaluation including CIFAR, ImageNet subsets, and more
SHOT_OPTIONS: review the default shot options for few-shot evaluation including zero-shot, 5, 20, 50 shots, and full fine-tuning
